scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Would you like to visit ^0000FFMorocc Raceway^000000?
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
您想去^0000FF梦罗克赛道^000000吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Alright, talk to me again when you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
好的，想去的时候再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Welcome to Morocc Raceway!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
欢迎来到梦罗克赛道！

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 了解规则

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Someone must click on the Starter NPC to start the race.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
需要有人点击发令员，比赛才会开始。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Once the race is started, run around Morocc anti-clockwise.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
比赛开始后，请沿逆时针方向绕梦罗克跑。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
You must reach all the checkpoints - No cheating!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
必须到达所有检查点——不许作弊！

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Come again soon!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
欢迎再次光临！

scripts.text:
[Race Starter]
Please stay on the Eastern side of me.
scripts.translation:
[赛跑发令员]
请待在我的东侧。

scripts.text: Start Race
scripts.translation: 开始比赛

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Counting down...
scripts.translation: 倒计时...
